high_level_description: Cinematic hand-painted anime illustration of a colossal living tree as a trusted threshold: a small app messenger waits outside while one uniquely shaped request rests inside the inspection hatch and a human custodian within decides whether to open it, with no text, arrows, diagrams, interfaces, or duplicates.

compositional_deconstruction.background: Clear turquoise morning sky above a pale-cream footpath bordered by deep teal moss and distant soft green hills. The path approaches the tree from the lower-left edge and continues nowhere beyond its roots, leaving quiet open sky around the upper canopy. Neutral daylight separates every silhouette. No readable text, letters, numbers, signs, arrows, flow lines, charts, interface panels, diagram boxes, cages, display cases, cables, secondary machines, repeated capsules, or decorative technology appear anywhere.

elements.desc: Colossal living threshold tree rising through the full page, with pale cream bark, deep teal leaves, coral sap scars, and roots forming an impassable natural boundary. A small round aperture crosses the solid trunk at chest height, while a sheltered working hollow opens only on the trusted right side beneath the canopy.

Protected local seed chest positioned deep inside the right-side hollow, built from dark teal wood with a closed cream door, one coral keyway, and three softly lit glass seed jars behind a reinforced window. No hinge, handle, opening, root passage, or reachable surface faces the outside messenger.

Single inspection hatch with its featured request capsule inside, treated as one unified transparent chamber fitted into the tree aperture. The coral-brass capsule has a precise three-lobed seed shape matching the cream inspection cradle exactly; shutters remain closed on both sides, and one wooden control lever exists only inside the right hollow.

Small free-roaming courier automaton waiting on the exterior left path, built from cream ceramic with teal joints, coral shoulder satchel, round dark eyes, and two short articulated arms. Its empty right hand remains open beside the submission slot after placing the only capsule, and its attentive gaze stays fixed on the sealed inspection chamber.

Local custodian standing entirely inside the sheltered right hollow, medium-brown skin, long silver braid, teal work coat, cream trousers, coral boots, calm concentrated expression, and gaze fixed on the capsule. Her left hand holds a matching three-lobed wooden gauge beside the chamber while her right hand alone rests on the closed control lever.
